4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Predictions continue to underpredict gains on winning tests while remaining overoptimistic for non-winning tests.
Sign-in hint (6 wins across 14 tests), home wait_info (3 wins across 10 tests), finish new_flow (2 wins across 8 tests), and adoption new_flow (2 wins across 4 tests) changes were helpful.
Sign-in reorder changes consistently reduced performance across 2 tests.
Choose_path copy, home redesign, home new_screen, and adoption incentive changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change types tested only once.

            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Sign-In Existing Account Rescue Hint
candidates.change: Display a prominent hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that logging into their existing account restores all previously created pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about missing or reset pets after sign-in. Sign-in hints have a high win rate (6/14 tests).

sign_in.hint: Signing into your existing account will automatically restore all your saved pets and progress.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Accessory Fitting Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive accessory fitting sub-flow during adoption where users can try starter hats and collars on their companion before confirmation.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (67.9%, median 89s). Adding interactive pet preview flows improves adoption engagement.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Live Generation Tip Cards
candidates.change: Show revolving interactive desktop tip cards during the waiting screen explaining pet habits while rendering finishes.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a high mean duration of 2336s (median 201s). Wait info improvements have 3 wins across 10 tests.

components.text: Your pet loves exploring active application windows! You can drag or minimize them anytime.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Interaction Hotkey Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Guide users through interactive hotkeys to summon, hide, and talk to their pet directly on the finish screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet. Finish new_flow changes have 2 wins in 8 tests.

components.text: Try hotkey Alt+P to toggle pet visibility on desktop

candidates.title: Account Pet Cloud Recovery Status Hint
candidates.change: Show a clear security and pet restoration guarantee hint right above the sign-in options.
candidates.why: Addresses 8 support tickets regarding lost pets on sign-in and leverages sign-in hint effectiveness (6/14 historical wins).

sign_in.hint: All custom pets are safely backed up to your account cloud and instantly synced upon signing in.

candidates.title: Companion Naming & Milestone Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated companion naming and birth certificate milestone screen before finalizing adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption drops to 67.9% completion. A dedicated naming and milestone step deepens pet attachment before rendering.

new_companion_milestone.headline: Welcome Your Companion
new_companion_milestone.body: Give your new desktop pet a name and select its favorite personality trait.

candidates.title: Finish Companion Command Guide Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home_intro screen into a stage layout showing visual desktop interaction controls and mouse shortcuts.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted confusion controlling/hiding pets, and 4 reported desktop feature misbehavior after setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Pet is Ready!
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet on desktop to open quick actions, or double-click to start a conversation.

home_welcome.text: Right-click: Context Menu | Double-click: Chat | Drag: Move around screen

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Generation Activity Feed Display
candidates.change: Display a dynamic asset construction activity feed on the waiting screen showing rendering progress step-by-step.
candidates.why: Home wait stage takes a mean time of 2336s. Keeping users informed of rendering progress reduces drop-off during long wait times.

candidates.title: Sign-In Cloud Sync Reassurance Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit data protection hint on the sign-in screen clarifying that account data transfer preserves all existing pet assets.
candidates.why: Sign-in hints have strong empirical success (6/14 wins) and directly counter user fear of pet loss mentioned in 8 support emails.

sign_in.hint: Your pet state and custom assets are safe. Signing in links your desktop companion across all your devices.

candidates.title: Finish Step Desktop Pet System Tray Toggle
candidates.change: Add an interactive toggle on the finish screen allowing users to enable system tray quick controls and desktop launch alerts.
candidates.why: 7 support emails were about post-onboarding controls/hiding or feature behavior. Enabling tray notifications on finish clarifies background controls.
